'''Vir Nurb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] who owned the modified [[Dartiss-5 Caravel]] space barge ''[[Lost Lady]]''. He used the ship as the basis of his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] career and the schemes he ran between [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="The Nebula Assassin" />
